front: Give the formula for unlevered free cash flow.
back: UFCF = EBIT × (1 − tax rate) + D&A − capex − increase in net working capital. It is the cash available to all capital providers.
$\text{WACC} = \dfrac{E}{V}r_E + \dfrac{D}{V}r_D(1-t)$, using market-value weights with V = E + D. Debt cost is after tax because interest is deductible.

front: Give the Gordon growth terminal value and its key trap.
back: $TV_N = \dfrac{FCF_N(1+g)}{\text{WACC} - g}$. The growth rate must be below WACC and sustainable forever (roughly long-run nominal GDP growth); small changes in g move the value a lot.

front: How do you move from enterprise value to equity value per share?
back: Equity value = EV − debt + cash − preferred stock − non-controlling interests (+ non-operating assets). Divide by diluted shares, e.g. using the treasury stock method for options.

front: Trap: why is EV/net income an inconsistent multiple?
back: The numerator and denominator must belong to the same capital providers. EV pairs with pre-interest metrics (revenue, EBITDA, EBIT); equity value (price) pairs with post-interest metrics like net income (P/E).

front: Why do precedent transaction multiples usually exceed trading comparables?
back: Acquisition prices include a control premium and expected synergies, while trading multiples reflect minority stakes in the open market.
